title: Expanding Sticky Wild
summary: Sticky variant of expanding-wild: an expanded reel stays fully wild for the rest of the free-spins round; towers accumulate up to a cap. Visuals, opening effect and sounds are identical to expanding-wild.

sticky.stickyFromLandingDetail: A tower must stay on screen from the moment it locks until the round ends — INCLUDING while the other reels are rolling. Do not tear it down at spin start and rebuild it after the board lands: the player sees the tower blink out every spin, which reads as losing the feature they were paid for. Our fix is a preserveStandingTowers flag that suppresses the spin-start teardown for the whole sticky round (src/game/ReelSet.ts, set at FS entry in PixiApp and cleared on FS exit).

towerMultipliers.note: Each sticky tower carries a ×1–×5 badge dealt when it JOINED and kept for the round; wins pay × the highest badge crossed. See features/tower-multipliers/.

multipliers.note: RETIRED, ships as 1 (implement as a no-op ×1). With stickyTowerCap 5 on a 5-reel grid, 'all towers standing' IS the full board, and the full board is already the INSTANT MAX WIN (maxWinMultiplier × bet, nothing multiplied on top, round ends). There is no payout left to double. A >1 value either does nothing or, applied before the max-win clamp, fabricates wins the certified model never paid. HISTORY: the old '>1 pushes RTP past 105%' rationale was written when the cap was 3 and there was no instant max win — at cap 3 the full board was an ordinary paying board that recurred nearly every 10-spin round. That reasoning no longer applies and must not be used to re-enable the field.
multipliers.towerBadgesAreTheMultiplier: The free-spins multiplier in this game is the per-tower ×1–×5 badge (custom.towerMultiplierWeights, highest-crossed rule). See features/tower-multipliers/.
